erin: Quick postmortem follow-up  locking owners and short timelines for span-loss, aggregation drift, and ETL lag. Posting a concise plan.

alex: Ill take span extractor backpressure. Temp: bump JVM + pin GC flags. Full: backpressure tokens + safer batching.

maria: Aggregator duplicates are from replayed retries. Plan: dedupe by (trace,span,batch) + metric agg.dedupe.hits. PR with tests incoming.

sam: ETL lag caused by a bad partition rollout + broker stall. Reverted; adding etl.lag_95 alert and emergency reassign runbook.

erin: Owners/timelines: A) alex - mitigation to staging today, canary 24h, full fix by 2026-04-10; B) maria - PR in 3d, canary next week; C) sam - tuning in 48h. Backups: kai covers span work if alex blocked.

deploy-bot: deploy started by alex at 1839990030  span-extractor/jvm-bump -> staging

alex: Staging looks better: consumer lag down ~30%, gc.pause_ms tail reduced. Monitoring span.kv.misses.

maria: Adding agg.dedupe.replays + agg.dedupe.hits. Tests assert idempotent increments on replay.

erin: Two systemic items: 1) chaos regression that simulates short GC pauses -> owner: maria -> ETA 2w; 2) weekly obs digest tile for agg.dedupe.hits, span.kv.misses, etl.lag_95 -> owner: erin -> ETA 1w.

sam: Runbook note + partition idle metric added. Linking logs to the postmortem doc.

erin: Customer blurb for support: "We've mitigated the causes of recent span loss and aggregation discrepancies. Engineers deployed mitigations and are rolling fixes; metrics should normalize within 48 hours." I'll send once staging is stable.

alex: Agreed. Daily 15m check-ins at 09:15 PST for 3 days. Ping me if blocked. :thumbsup:
